description: Header file defining the OMXNodeInstance class, which manages an OpenMAX IL node instance in Android's media framework. It includes method declarations for configuring, controlling, and handling OMX node operations, as well as internal data structures and callback functions.

classes.name: OMXNodeInstance
classes.description: Represents an instance of an OMX node, providing methods for configuration, buffer management, event handling, and internal state management.

methods.name: setHandle
methods.description: Sets the OMX handle for this node instance.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Returns the OMX handle associated with this node.

methods.name: observer
methods.description: Returns the observer associated with this node.

methods.name: freeNode
methods.description: Frees the OMX node resources.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the OMX node.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter from the OMX node.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the OMX node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration from the OMX node.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets a configuration on the OMX node.

methods.name: setPortMode
methods.description: Configures the mode of a specific port.

methods.name: getGraphicBufferUsage
methods.description: Gets the usage flags for graphic buffers on a port.

methods.name: prepareForAdaptivePlayback
methods.description: Prepares the node for adaptive playback with specified parameters.

methods.name: configureVideoTunnelMode
methods.description: Configures video tunneling mode for a port.

methods.name: setInputSurface
methods.description: Sets the input surface buffer source.

methods.name: allocateSecureBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a secure buffer for a port.

methods.name: useBuffer
methods.description: Uses a buffer for a port.

methods.name: freeBuffer
methods.description: Frees a buffer from a port.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills a buffer with data.

methods.name: emptyBuffer
methods.description: Empties a buffer to the OMX node.

methods.name: getExtensionIndex
methods.description: Retrieves the index of an extension parameter.

methods.name: setQuirks
methods.description: Sets specific quirks for the OMX node.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the OMX node.

methods.name: onMessages
methods.description: Handles incoming messages.

methods.name: onObserverDied
methods.description: Handles observer death event.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Handles OMX events.

methods.name: storeMetaDataInBuffers_l
methods.description: Stores metadata in buffers.

methods.name: updateGraphicBufferInMeta_l
methods.description: Updates graphic buffer handle in metadata.

methods.name: getBufferSource
methods.description: Returns the current buffer source.

methods.name: setBufferSource
methods.description: Sets the buffer source.
